name_reason: Already conforms to the global naming convention: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle core table), summon_anim_variant_d domain descriptor, 4slot reflects the genuine int[4] dimension (init loop writes 4 elements: CMP EBX,0x4 at 0x2732E), frame_counter_array reflects array data type and purpose. The 4 in '4slot' is a real array-dimension semantic, not a Ghidra address residue: the array is verified 4 ints wide (0x540A7-0x54097=0x10=16=4*4), and the accessor fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot is named for the 3 *active* slots advanced during tick (CMP EBX,0x3 at 0x27426) vs 4 slots seeded at init. No hex suffix matching any address.
purpose: Per-slot frame counter array for the variant-D summon-spell animation; one signed 32-bit entry per sprite slot, driving each slot's blit frame and the staggered ramp-up / color-rotation timing.
logic_summary: Zero-bss runtime scratch (int[4]). INIT (state_code 0) seeds all 4 slots staggered negative: frame_counter[i] = -3*i (0,-3,-6,-9). TICK frames (state_code 2/5/8) iterate only the first 3 slots (slot 3 stays idle): blit when 0<=frame<5 (signed compare CMP [EAX+0x54097],0x0 / JL at 0x27434); on even ticks advance frame_counter[i] (INC at 0x273C9), set done at frame 2, and at frame 7 (unless terminate flag) reset to 0 and pick the next rotated color. Accessed exclusively by fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot (write at 0x2731F init, INC at 0x273C9, wrap-store 0 at 0x2741B; reads at 0x273D0/0x273E4/0x27434/0x2743D/0x2745B/0x27478).
element_semantics: Each element is a signed per-slot frame counter for one summon sprite slot. Negative values are a deliberate staggered start (slot i begins at -3*i) so slots ramp up at different times; the value is interpreted signed and only blits while 0<=frame<5. Slots 0..2 are active in tick; slot 3 is seeded but never advanced.
